killedBy: hud: the pause exit is contextual (issue #323) reopens the setup a player CHOSE, not a fresh one (issue #261)
why: Change Setup reopens the pane with a hardcoded default instead of what the player chose, so the button that exists to ADJUST a configuration discards it. THE GAP WAS REAL AND MEASURED: this exact mutation passed all 1833 tests in `src/game/` before the killer above was written. The sibling cases proved the pane opens and proved the call order; nothing asserted what it opened ONTO, which is the half issue #261's criterion is about ("return to the retained VS Setup"). Found by an adversarial audit of that criterion rather than by the change that introduced the button. RE-ANCHORED for issue #566: the handler's two calls became one `quitInto`, so this entry's find string stopped matching and it reported FAILED-TO-APPLY -- a guard that had stopped guarding, reported by the sweep and by nothing else.
